name: Multivitamin & Multimineral [A-Z teen girls preparation]
indication_description: Complete Multivitamin for teen girls to Support: Healthy skin function with Vitamin A, C, Copper & Iron; Healthy immune system with vitamins A, C and E, zinc, iron and selenium; Bone strength with calcium, vitamin D, and magnesium; Energy through the conversion of food to fuel with vitamins B6 and B12, thiamin, riboflavin, and niacin.
pharmacology_description: This preparation is a comprehensive multivitamin and mineral supplement designed to help teen girls to meet their increased nutritional needs.
dosage_description: For teen girls, one tablet daily with food.
contraindications_description: This product is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients.
side_effects_description: Allergic sensitization has been reported following oral administration of folic acid.
precautions_description: Accidental overdose if an iron-containing product is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children less than 6 years. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor immediately. Keep out of reach of children.
storage_conditions_description: Store in cool dry place & away from children.
